forecaster_note: Sat: short-period SSE/SE + mixed E swells, S magnets head high plus, elsewhere waist–chest; onshore, bumpy to lumpy but better than Fri — best early. Sun: SE/E mix, head high at S exposures; offshore and clean in the morning, onshore and lumpy from later morning. Mon: smaller peaky waist–chest, clean-ish AM at S magnets/N corners. Tue: weak, junky short-period surf. — Surfline forecaster (Anthony Spinks), Sat 17 Oct

days.note: SE 5.8ft @ 9s (~571 kJ) + small E swells. Onshore ESE all day — lumpy but better than Fri. Long Reef/Curl Curl biggest; go early on the low.
days.surfline_text: Short period SSE/SE swell is joined by some mixed easterly swells. Sth magnets will still be picking up the most size - in the head high plus range. Most other beaches will be waist to chest. We're still going to be battling the onshore winds - best chance for something cleaner is the early morning. It will be bumpy to lumpy, but better than Friday.
